technology.short_description: It is no easy trick of necromancy to push the slow trudge of the rotting ranks into a rapid advance that can dive headlong into a target.
Given time, a more considered process of corpse-raising allows wards to be bound, making a Zombie more resilient than one raised in haste.
Pain, fear and exhaustion mean nothing to corpses raised to obey the command to endure and given the arcane means to do so.
Bounding across fields of the fallen, the flesh-eaters pounce upon foes with blood-curdling roars, pausing only to gorge on the dead beneath them.
Drawn from the most hardened ancient retinues, these heroes of war are as implacable and unyielding in death as they were in life.
Blood-gorged and saturated with their dark masters' sorceries, some beasts can shrug off wounds that should have slain them many times over.
Lycindia rules through punishment and fear, finding beauty only in the obedience brought with suffering.
Naaima smiles as empires tangle themselves in plots set in motion by her single whispered word.
Heterneb carries memories from the first nights of Lahmia, and in her presence younger immortals remember their place.
Bellatash moves like moonlight over marble – cold and flawless – with murder hidden behind every soft word.
Giselle's unnatural grace and hypnotic allure leave mortals spellbound long before they realise they stand before a monster.
Blessed be the ties that bind, for they shall last forever.

technology.short_description: Favouring the Zombies with more bulk to them means a host that absorbs more punishment, afforded by the rot of their remaining flesh.
As blood touches the slavering lips of these wretched creatures, they grow ravenous and hollow-eyed, strengthening with each bite.
Forged for kings and buried with champions, the Grave Guards' ancient armaments still carry the gravitas of the long-dead who once wielded them.
Howls, screeches, and glowing eyes flit from the gloom of accursed places, where the clawed, the fanged, and the hook-winged thrive.
From the courts of Malstonia comes Lycindia, a Handmaiden whose elegance conceals a taste for exquisite cruelty.
From distant Cathay comes Naaima, trained in patient schemes, veiled influence, and the quiet art of turning rivals upon themselves.
Heterneb is a relic of the first courts, her counsel sharpened by centuries of blood, betrayal and survival.
Raised amidst the intrigue and blood-soaked courts of Tilea, Bellatash is as deadly with promises as with concealed blades.
Giselle brings the refinement of Marienburg's high courts into the Coven, where charm is merely another kind of sharpened blade.
The coming of death isn't necessarily a disadvantage, and can even prove the most special of boons.

technology.short_description: In time, the Skeleton ranks harden – bone and rust alike – as they advance with the patience of a tomb.
Corpse-raising offers a great destiny to the Necromancer, and an even greater one to the corpse, which would otherwise merely rot in the earth.
The longer ancient bones remain under a puppet master’s control, the easier they are to drive relentlessly and uncaringly towards their callous ends.
Beware a tomb lid ajar or an unhinged mausoleum door, accompanied by the cracking of bones in the darkness…
Iron wills and ancient oaths once spurred on those now made up of little more than reanimated bone, rusty armour, and jagged blades.
The more haunted the world becomes, the better habitat it is for the fell things that wish to drive the terrified into the darkness.
The Handmaidens are schooled in discretion, misdirection and the delicate work of silencing those who have seen too much.
Contained within, the secrets of holding together - quite literally - a rotting horde of Zombies.

Imentet stands as the first chosen Handmaiden, setting the standard by which all others in the Coven shall be judged.
Elevated above her sisters, Imentet commands the Handmaidens with the poise of a queen and the patience of a spider.

technology.short_description: The city of the master shall be served, its ever-multiplying Undead servants shambling in shadow, awaiting the call of their Necromancer keepers.
An eerie twilight lingers over the land. The warmth of the daylight sun feels somehow lesser, the nights darker and filled with terrors.
When countless riven souls of the dead can be molded to one's will with such ease, even Undead Champions take heed.
A powerful life force makes for hardy Undead warriors, many of whom can regenerate their form and strength with little assistance.
The black soul of some creatures hungers for the crimson wine of blood. It is an all-consuming thirst, never to be satiated.
Many tomb-risen wraiths and cairns of the earth still clasp ensorcelled blades of ancient provenance, eager to let them bite flesh once more.
The Undead riders wield their lances with a finesse and technique akin to the skilled horsemen they once were in life.
Of all the devolved, twisted creatures born of excess gore-feasting, few can withstand the fury of those unchained for war.
Call down the taloned monstrosities, let their deathly stink linger long after their talons have sundered armour, flesh and resolve.
Through dark rituals empowered by the Winds of Death, eerie parades of lost spirits resist all but the strongest weaponry brought to bear against them.
While a Handmaiden's flawless composure would have you believe otherwise, they are eager to sate their hunger.
As the Covens spread, hidden chambers are prepared to house the training of Handmaidens in every lair of influence.
Using a litany from a language not spoken for generations, the speaker can bind malevolent spirits to his cause.

technology.short_description: Necromantic scrying and rituals help return Vampires and other creatures to full strength if the safety of their own crypts is not a viable option.
Through ancient ritual, the vampiric empower themselves for battle, also bolstering the magic that binds spirit creatures to the world for longer periods.
Stirred to war are lambent, spectral horrors without form, almost impossible to touch, let alone harm.
"Give me at least dozen Knights, fully armed and hungry for battle. Be they alive or dead, the deed shall be done."
There are some beasts, as swift as they are savage, that even Undead Lords of great age come to fear, if not seek to control.
Any modicum of control over the monsters that hunt beneath the moon requires one to endure its death-heralding, ear-bursting shriek.
Decorations and effigies of bones, wings and skulls adorn the infernal carriages' flanks, distracting from iron-forged plating beneath.
The combination of a Lahmian's unnatural speed and flawless footwork make for unrivalled evasion.
Many Handmaidens are assigned their own personal horse-drawn carriages, allowing them to move with real haste and privacy.
Core to the establishment of every Coven is an escape plan for any unforeseen mishap.
Nobles seduced in advance of our Coven's establishment will provide access to their prime real estate.
A Handmaiden need not fear the dagger in the back.
Famed Vampires, young and old, rise to join the ranks, bringing a wealth of experience to help conquer the lands of the living in your name.

technology.short_description: To raise a zombie or skeleton is child’s play – true martial mastery of the spirit world requires more of one’s soul.
It is the natural order of things that the bloodthirsty nature of war endlessly swells the ranks of the Undead.
Where the Winds of Shyish blow strongest, the bodies of the Undead ranks are replaced the easiest.
We must be careful to avoid the ire of the highest in society – unless they join the Sisterhood too, of course.
The Winds blow where death is prevalent, lingering in the lands where decay and brooding dead things lurk.
Illusion, darkness and silhouettes become weapons in the hands of those who thrive behind veils and daggers.

"Beware all ye who open this accursed tome, lest you lose your soul to the dark knowledge within."
